records.title: OOQ: Outlier-Oriented Quantization for Efficient Large Language Models
records.reason: DOI/title identity is resolved, and the IEEE publisher endpoint was attempted. The primary abstract was inaccessible; secondary summaries suggest LLM quantization, but they are not used to decide relevance, so the candidate remains borderline pending primary text.

records.title: R2Q: Towards Robust 2-Bit Large Language Models via Residual Refinement Quantization
records.reason: R2Q targets 2-bit LLM compression and reports quantized-model quality improvements; low-bit deployment is directly in scope.

records.title: CIS: Checkpointed Inference for Data Drift-Resilient Model Serving at Edge Servers
records.reason: The DOI and title resolve to an edge model-serving paper, but the ACM primary abstract/full text was not retrievable through the attempted DOI route. The model/domain and whether its checkpointed inference system applies to LLM serving remain unconfirmed, so borderline is retained.

records.title: Striking the Right Balance between Compute and Copy: Improving LLM Inferencing Under Speculative Decoding
records.reason: BMC addresses KV allocation/copy overhead and reuses excess rows for speculative decoding to improve LLM token-generation efficiency.

records.title: DualSpar: A Dual-Granularity Memory Framework with Adaptive Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: DOI/title identity matches the candidate, and the IEEE Xplore route was attempted but unavailable. The primary abstract could not substantiate the proposed adaptive sparse KV-cache mechanism or its inference efficiency claims; secondary summaries are not used as substitutes.

records.title: ScaleMoE: A Fast and Scalable Distributed Training Framework for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts Models
records.reason: The official title explicitly scopes the framework to distributed MoE training; the local workflow excludes training-only acceleration absent a demonstrated inference-serving connection.

records.title: Conv-Basis: A New Paradigm for Efficient Attention Inference and Gradient Computation in Transformers
records.reason: Conv-Basis approximates transformer attention and computes inference through FFT in near-linear time, with explicit LLM/long-context applicability.

records.title: Attention-Level Speculation
records.reason: PMLR resolves the Semantic Scholar identity to the ICML paper; ALSpec overlaps parallel devices and attention work to reduce long-context decode latency.
